intro: Find the 5 stars to finish the house. House by Ward Hartenstein.
outro:
The real world may look a bit different 
  now that you've been to the Land of Illusion!

meta.source: Glider PRO (Casady & Greene, 1994), GNU GPL v2: https://github.com/softdorothy/GliderPRO
notes: 14 walls or floors with two openings: one opening here, the wall between them drawn as a block (Gliderama has one opening per side)
19 doorways were one-way in the original (open on one side only); here they open both ways
26 openings closed and 38 narrowed by walls of invisible obstacles at the rooms' edges
3 transports put the glider down inside another one, which takes it straight on (as in Glider PRO): here they take the plane to the end of the chain
